backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and admin-restricted endpoints using AccessControl, including profile CRUD, role queries, admin list, and a protected Google Sheets URL.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and tests with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference file containing prewritten summaries of many frontend components, hooks, charts, and assets.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH-driven light/dark theme variables and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React main bundle and setting the page title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling auth, admin gating, navigation, profile setup, and conditional fetching of the admin-only download link.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI card prompting non-admin users that access is denied and providing a button to go to the profile page.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: Recharts CO2 chart rendering multiple CO2 series with tooltips, legends, brush-based zoom, and synchronized time handling.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: Generates a Recharts line chart showing cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages with formatted timestamps and brush range selection.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: A reusable card component with a title, optional header action, and styled content container.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: Renders a multi-axis line chart displaying fan voltages and flow control pressure with tooltips and range selection.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: Provides a title bar with navigation, theme toggle, refresh, profile menu, and optional download button logic.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: Dropdown menu for user account actions including principal display, copy, navigation, and sign-out.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting the user to enter and save their profile name during initial setup.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: Displays filtered and setpoint temperature data on a line chart with formatted tooltips and legend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: Fetches the admin list using the current actor, enabled only when the actor is available and ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and returns the current user's profile using react-query, tracking loading and actor readiness.
Derives a global last-updated timestamp from the temperature-series query cache and formats it.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: Retrieves a Google Sheets download link via the actor, caching it indefinitely when enabled.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and context management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: Manages navigation between log system pages with next, previous, and direct page selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports hooks for saving user profiles and granting admin role, invalidating profile queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Manages a synchronized time window for chart ranges with zooming and reset functionality.
Fetches temperature-series data without auto-refresh and tracks manual refresh timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: Stores and toggles dark/light theme mode in session storage and syncs it to the document class.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, including chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature data from a remote URL, validates it, and parses it into structured points.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Parses raw temperature and CO2 data, converting formats and filtering out invalid datapoints.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Defines available log system pages with IDs, labels, and component references.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login UI and triggers Internet Identity authentication with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page allowing users to view and edit their name, copy principals, and for admins to view and manage the admin list.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: Interactive dashboard showing temperature-related charts with date-range filtering, zooming, and data refetching.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLogger1Page.tsx: Empty placeholder page rendering a blank container.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending typography, colors, fonts, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, features, issues, and admin-related requirements.
